strokes.text: Manages one media source that plays a local file, with typed playback settings, and its first placement in a scene.
It is the typed form of @resources/source for the `ffmpeg_source` kind.
Reading the resource observes the playback state without starting, stopping or seeking the media.
Changing a playback setting can restart the media in OBS.
Import by collection name, source UUID, anchor scene UUID and anchor scene item ID, separated by pipe characters:

glazes.close_when_inactive: Whether OBS closes the file while the source is not showing.
glazes.is_local_file: Must be `true`: only local files are supported.
glazes.local_file: Absolute path of the media file.
glazes.name: Name of the source as shown in OBS. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.observed_media_cursor: Playback position in milliseconds at the last read.
glazes.observed_media_duration: Length of the media in milliseconds, as OBS reported it.
glazes.observed_media_state: Playback state that OBS reported at the last read.
glazes.restart_on_activate: Whether playback restarts each time the source becomes active.
